You have to catch eight different crooks who want to rob the magazine's main offices within 100 turns.

169204.overview: A simple crosshair shooter in the German language developed by M. Mirgel and published by Rätz-Eberle Verlag in 1985 as part of Computer Kontakt 1985/02

170991.overview: The ring cycle in text adventure form with graphics. German Language only.

171337.overview:
Dustin is a tiny robot who has been tasked with cleaning the dust from the innards of the world's best 8-bit computer!

Guide him around and help him clean up the dust particles - but watch out for electrical pulses that move across the circuit, they will fry him! Dustin' makes me feel good...

Created for the Reset Magazine's 2018 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

171703.overview:
Concentration and reasoning are two essential skills required to play Magic Tile\Duddo. IN practice, it is necessary to arrange all the available pieces on a chessboard in order to pass to the next level. The number of pieces remaining is indicated at the bottom of the screen and the piece to be placed at the the moment is indicated by an arrow. To position the pieces you must follow these criteria: They can only be placed next to other tiles of the same color or figure. If you can place a tile next to several tiles you will get bonus points. At the beginning you can select from various options including players, level of difficulty and saving and restoring games from disk. 

Published in Italy as Duddo in New Games Nuova serie n.6 (Febbrao 1993).

171721.overview: Perhaps this logic puzzle by Zoran Tomaskovic will be the magic bullet to remove your boredom and expand your brain.

171805.overview: A text adventure sequel to the original "The Return of Sammy Marlo", the titular character of Sam Marlo is a probable mix of Sam (Spade) and (Philip) Marlowe, both fictional hard boiled private detective characters. In it you play a detective who needs to follow the clues to the murderer and put him away.  Published in Loadstar #250.

171822.overview:
GameTek's home version of the classic game show The Price is Right. Bob Barker and the Beauties are not present, but a multitude of pricing games from the show, as well as the wheel and the showcase, have been faithfully replicated.

Four (or a maximum of eight, counting both rounds - the programme suggests switching players) contestants can play, with the computer filling in for the rest. Whether bidding on Contestant's Row or playing a pricing game, contestants will attempt to closely guess the price of an item provided. All items in the game are often-unintentionally-humorous misspellings of recognizable brand names, to avoid trademark infringement.

Pricing games include the Mountain Climbing (in which your 3 guesses must be less than $300 away in total, otherwise a goat will push you over the edge), Safe Cracking (in which you have 3 possibilities for each part of the price, and must correctly guess it) and the Dice Game (in which you accept or reject random rolls to get the real price).

There is a persistent Hall of Fame with winners and their scores, and a parser for guessing/bidding prices. Players have to type in their price guesses, and answer to the math of how "off" they were, as they would if they were on the show.

172629.overview:
The 7 Doctors (or The Seven Doctors) is a z-machine based text adventure based on The popular BBC Science Fiction series Doctor Who. The original was written by David Burke in 2018. The Commodore 64 version was converted by Scott Breon via a Z-Machine conversion website in 2019.

In this game you play the seventh incarnation of The Doctor (Sylvester McCoy). Various enemies have kidnapped and imprisoned your other six previous incarnations, and it's up to you to save each and every one of them, for if you don't your death becomes a fixed point in time.

172768.overview: The cult, a spooky, creepy text adventure written in Dutch and released in the Netherlands. You have to search for the fortune of the late Leon H. Rabburd hidden in a booby-trapped church.

173642.overview:
COMPUTE! 1984/01 (Issue #44), Super VIC & C64 A1-N2 (July/August 1984) / called "Demoni di Osiris" in the Italian magazine. Published in Super VIC & C64 game pack in Italy. You must defend your fleet of base ships against wave after wave of lightning-fast Osirian attackers as they weave and dodge through your covering fire. The Osirians do not descend blindly; they counter your evasive moves and seek you out. Theirs is a maniacal mission.  
 
The object is to shoot the falling Osirians, but at the same time they'll use their intelligence to try to destroy you. You can choose from 240 speed levels, with level 1 being the fastest. You may also choose between 1-240 base ships. Be prepared to battle as many as eight Osirians at a time.

174151.overview:
Not to be confused with 1989's Darkland: The Last Realm, this game is a SEUCK shooter with pseudo Lovecraftian horror elements made by legendary SEUCK developer Alf Yngve and published by TND in 2015.

The entire game is played in near darkness, and you have to shine a flashlight around in order to find various enemies/monsters to kill.

174181.overview: Very different from the original 1983 release, this version of the game for the Commodore 64 was released as a game sample for "Garry Kitchen's GameMaker" an application for guided game design and features a much less blocky design.

174394.overview:
Story: 

Doc Cosmos is on the search for a powerful alien device that is rumoured to be able to allow the user to time travel. He arrives on the alien planet to begin his quest to obtain the device but soon gets stuck in the underground complex.

Use the device to switch between timelines to change Docs control scheme and alter the scenery in order to progress through the complex and find a way out. Search for keys to open the multitude of doors blocking Docs way. With your help Doc can get out with the device and begin his adventures in time!

Features:

    Large map with 47 screens and two versions of each one!
    Timeline system, switch between different timelines and change the scenery
    Dual Control system, Doc controls differently in each timeline

Controls:

Joystick in Port2 - Left/Right to walk, Up to jump and Fire to activate device when charged

Left/Right on title screen to select music mode 

Won the 2019 Freeze64 Game of the Year award.

174650.overview: A highly recommended platforming game created by Hans J. Baer and published in Magic Disk 64 1989/08. The game can be quite frustrating as there are lots of different paths to take and only one exit. Also unlike other games the enemies are totally random in their movements.

175219.overview:
Remember those first days at work? When you were asked to go and get a left handed hammer from the hardware store, or asked to use a computer where they've turned the background picture into a screenshot of the desktop... Well think yourself lucky you didn't go to Druid college, like poor Eino here, applying for the role of Arch Druid in Demons of Dex. A brand new roguelike dungeon crawler from Digital Monastery, the game development arm of Hokuto Force. He's been sent to fight the hell spawn, inhabiting the depths of dungeon Dex, with nothing but a robe and a rusty knife. I expect if you manage to survive the 30 levels, you'll meet one of your Druid colleagues, who'll tell you it was all one big joke.

You start the game with a melee weapon, able to attack enemies, and beat down doors, in an effort to find the steps leading to the next level. You'll encounter a variety of enemies from rats and bats, to undead, orcs, demons and even invisible stalkers and fast spawning slimes. You'll need to explore everywhere to find the powerups required to fight in the later tougher levels. Potions restore health, gems reveal the current level's layout, the staff offers a ranged lightning attack, useful to weaken enemies before engaging in melee. Invisibility cloaks can also be found, as well as the super powerful "Ankh" spell, which will kill all enemies nearby, but you won't be rewarded with XP for these kills.. which will cost you later when you find you're not a high enough level to kill the tougher demons.

This game is a fully featured, well executed roguelike, easily the best on the platform, and one of the best I've played on any platform, for many years. From the docs, to the extensive game mods and graphical options.. You can even play in old school ascii mode, for a more authentic rogue experience (it was originally a unix based game drawn entirely in ascii font). When you've finished the game you can try in extended mode with larger maps, or hard mode with more levels and demons. This game was built with love, and most importantly total respect for the platform's capabilities.

175223.overview:
Rallye is a single-player motorcycle racing game published by Brillant Software in 1985 and released in Italy as Desert Race in Peek n.15 (marzo 1986).  
 
You have to face a grueling motorcycle race in the African desert. The raid is divided into four stages, each of which is covered only if the previous one has been completed within the time limit of five minutes. Be careful not to hit thee boulders scattered along the road, otherwise you will lose precious seconds. You can choose between three difficulty levels, plus one for driving training, in which there are no opponents crowding you. The joystick allws you to control the speed and trajectory of the bike. Up to accelerate, down to brake, left and right steer in that direction and fire to throttle shift.

175596.overview:
Based on the Italian comics character Dylan Dog, London "nightmare detective", Il Castello delle Illusioni (The Castle of Illusions) is a top vertical action/shooting game made with SEUCK (Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit).

You as Dylan Dog should find his butler Groucho imprisoned in the Castle of Illusions. Dylan armed with revolver should progress in vertical direction, moving in 8 directions and shooting or avoiding the attacks of enemies such as bats, dark monks, skeletons, ghosts, etc. Eliminating the enemies and certain items will increase your score. Each 10,000 points give you extra life.

Published in Commodore Computer Club Nr.6 [v2].

175768.overview: Basic learning cartridge for teaching grade 2 and 3 students the steps of addition and subtraction. All guided by the counting lion sprite...

175769.overview: Basic learning cartridge for teaching grade 3 and 4 students the steps of addition and subtraction. Once again the ubiquitous counting lion sprite is present to guide children through all the bits.

175770.overview: Basic learning cartridge for teaching grade 3 and 4 students the steps of geometry. All guided by the counting lion sprite...

175771.overview: Basic learning cartridge for teaching grade 1 students the initial steps of mathematics. All guided by the counting lion sprite...

175772.overview: Basic learning cartridge for teaching grade 2 and 3 students the steps of multiplication and division. All guided by the counting lion sprite...

175773.overview: Basic learning cartridge for teaching grade 3 and 4 students the steps of multiplication and division. Once again the ubiquitous counting lion sprite is present to guide children through all the bits.

176322.overview:
In this game you play as the controller of a number of Drones, that have been sent to defend the Earth from a mighty Alien hostile planet known as the Destroyer which is hurtling towards Earth! 

Your mission is to fly across a number of zones and destroy all the Alien waves that are coming your way, but be warned at the end of it all, there are big bosses that will really put your shoot em up skills to the test. This is one challenging game as bullets will go in all directions, the enemies are deadly and after the fourth zone you need to destroy the planet once and for all... 

Published in Scene World #27.

176323.overview:
An unofficial sequel to the well known Pinball game by the group Fairlight. In principle the same pinball only with improved graphics and covered SID tunes... also the physical behaviour seems to have changed.. 
 
Published in Italy by Pubblirome\Edigamma publishing as Mega Tilt in Super C64 e C128 n.34 (maggio 1989) and several other publications.

176324.overview:
A text adventure game published as a type-in game in the book "Castles & Kingdoms". 

The youth was curious. He'd heard many tales told by wandering minstrels. They spoke of dark and deadly dungeons in whispered, cautioning tones, as if something dreadful awaited anyone entering those murky depths. Yet it seemed to the 
youth that they were hiding something wonderful from him. He thirsted for treasure and his little-used blade hungered for the excitement of the storybook heroes, hungered for the blood of Not men on its tip. The youth had been born and 
raised on the lower Delta River plain. He'd wandered among the bullrushes and swum in the deep waters. He'd rafted the rapids below Smaegor's cavern and dared the upstream Temple. He'd even seen the Manatee once, but had swum away, very quickly. But not until now had he braved the Dungeon in the Glades. For there lay illusion, creatures and traps - according to one who'd returned to the youth's village and spoken of the horrors of his journey to the attentive firelight warriors. Now the youth would show his mettle. He would brave the Deadly Dungeon and show the cowards of his village that he was now a man. He entered the Dungeon and, though warned, continued onwards. The dank walls flickered in shadow caused by his torch. Something moved. The youth dodged, but not fast enough. He screamed in 
terror, and then screamed and screamed again until the sound died in his throat.  

Dragged away in soundless panic, he was taken to the depths of the Dungeon. His torch lay burning where it had been dropped on the floor, while the shadows danced in a silent epitaph to the death of a foolish youth.

176345.overview:
A text adventure game published as a type-in game in the book "Castles & Kingdoms". 

The Dragon Smaegor was old. His bones creaked with the weight of the years and his body ached with the scars of old wounds. He was tired. He wanted to lie down and sleep. But the matters of Dragondom pressed heavily upon him. He was, after all, Smaegor, Monarch of all Dragonkind, and there were duties to perform. From his lair, high in the caverns above the pillar, he stirred. Men and Graylocks had plagued Dragonkind for many centuries. They sought out Smaegor's subjects and slew them outright when they could. And when they could not, they hounded them until they could do little else but flee. Where Dragons had once ruled the Delta River Valley, now only a very few remained. Despite such persecution, Dragonkind were nevertheless still peaceful. But Smaegor had been informed of the loss of a grandling, a victim of Royal Guardsmen on a hunt. The grandling had been helpless, slain by the King's soldiers enjoying their sport. So Smaegor stirred, and took to the skies over the River Delta. He descended on the Palace garden in a fit of fury and grabbed the King's only daughter in his main claw. He rose in the air and circled the Palace. Far out of range of the volleys of arrows being loosed by the Guardsmen, he roared a challenge to the warm bloods below. It was a traditional challenge of personal combat which he knew one of the wise Elders would translate to the King. At sundown the Princess would be consumed in a ritual sacrifice to avenge the death of the grandling. Smaegor vanished into the clouds and returned, unseen, to his cave to await his opponent. The Fighter came to the Palace within moments of Smaegor's raid. He expressed sorrow at the loss of the Princess and asked the King what he might do to help .. 

"You must rescue her before sundown," said the King, who opened a passage leading to a storeroom. "Take what you need and save her please!" The Fighter knew the Delta River Valley well. He knew that there were things he would need if he were to defeat the mighty Smaegor and secure the return of the Princess. There was the dark wood and the alchemist beyond. There was the River Delta and the dock where there was always a rowing-boat moored, ready for use by anyone who might need it. There was the Temple and a sword sunk into a stone. Even the river - that lazy muddy mass - held secrets. The Fighter held a deity stone. With this he could ask for help to guide him. The gem, however, was flawed, so the advice wasn't always accurate. Then there was Old Smaegor himself, a tough, wizened old Dragon, waiting for the Fighter in his lair. Smaegor the angry, Smaegor the intelligent. What traps were laid in the caverns, the Fighter could not tell. He shouldered his supplies from the King's storeroom and bid the monarch farewell. "It's going to be a long day," he mused to himself. "And the Dragon awaits..."

176657.overview:
The game features some pretty smart breath-taking enhancements, which smashes the game hard into the T.N.D Quality label. Inspired by Uridium, W.A.R and other classic C64 titles.

Greetings Pilot. Prepare for the Delta Run ... The Space Pirates have been raiding passers by across the Galaxy. Nowhere is now safe in space. Space Agents have discovered that pirates have built 4 Delta Bases. Two in space, and two on board their planet. The last Delta Base was severly damaged under construction. On each Delta Base, you will be fighting against assorted alien space pirates. Your job is to simply infiltrate them and their guardians. Pick up crystals to score bonus points, gain extra lives or power ups. Can you clear all 4 Delta Bases and leave one final surprise for the Space Pirates? Their fate is in your hands. Good luck!

Originally released in the Spanish SEUCK Compo 2017.

176801.overview: Deff-Ender is a shoot 'em up developed by Richard Bayliss in 2011 for the 2011 Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit Compo. The game borrows somewhat from Defender, but doesn't have a radar/sonar window  on the screen.

177192.overview: An R-type style horizontally scrolling space-shooter with awesome music, formidable gameplay and beautiful graphics, thanks to the guys at Onslaught & GTW64 for preserving this one. It has a neat feature like a shop to purchase upgrades/more lives using coins collected.

177221.overview:
Published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1983/09 (Issue #3). 
 
Your universe is being invaded by Demon Stars, which appear at unpredictable intervals and can destroy all life forms in their vicinity. A defense shield protects your home area, but vast amounts of energy are needed to maintain it. Your mission: to penetrate lifeless areas already devastated by Demon Stars and to transmit energy units back to your home planet.  
 
Your starship moves horizontally, vertically, and diagonally, controlled by a joystick. The joystick fire button shoots matter conversion torpedoes. When you are not busy defending yourself from Demon Stars or chasing dangerous Quasars, you convert celestial objects into valuable energy units by scoring direct hits with your torpedoes. Nebulae net you five energy units, single-spiral galaxies ten units, stars 15, and double-spiral galaxies 20. Quasars appear frequently, accompanied by a deep-pitched warning sound. If you do not destroy a Quasar before it disappears, you lose 500 energy units. An energy drop below zero destroys your ship, as does a
collision with any celestial object. Demon Stars show up less frequently than Quasars, but they are far more dangerous. Their negative energy field restricts the 
range of your torpedoes, and failing to hit a Demon Star within the allotted time costs you your ship.

177222.overview:
ROGUE-LIKE SPACE CRAWLER MEET YOUR CARGO QUOTA - EVADE OR DESTROY THREATS

You are a highly skilled contract privateer in interstellar trade. You are employed to traverse multiple star systems picking up cargo capsules to be safely delivered back to your trade guild's starbase. You must fulfill your quota of cargo, supplemented by eliminating threats and foes such as star pirates and killjoy extremists who either want to steal your wares or otherwise engage in nefarious activities such as the slave trade that is rife across the galaxies.   Navigate your ship equipped with advanced interstellar overdrive warp engines by using your star map / radar display. Make use of your laser cannons against enemy craft threats and fleets in a struggle against overwhelming odds.

GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS: Hover over cargo capsules until your ship transports them to your ship's cargo hold. After complete an icon representing cargo contents will be displayed and your score/cargo quantity will be incremented.

177223.overview: Can you safely investigate the Clayman Caverns, past the angry dwarf, past traps and Troglodytes, navigate past Medusa and survive the Bronze Dragon who guards an enormous gold hoard.

177376.overview:
A fantasy text-adventure roll playing game based on a PET version that was released in 1980. The player starts on a random location in a dungeon a number of levels down, with the goal to escape to the surface. Each level of the dungeon is divided into an 8 x 8 grid, where different rooms contain passageways, combats, stairs, rogue encounters, or other surprises. On each level, the player must find an enchanted key, which allows them to unlock the staircase to the next level up, to eventually escape the dungeon. The player can also find a map which shows the layout for that level of the dungeon. Two levels of difficulty are available to challenge the player.

Combat is entered randomly as the player moves between rooms. This is turn-based, where the player take turns striking at each other, and the player can choose to try to flee between combat rounds. The player replenishes health when moving up a dungeon level or by finding a magic potion.

177379.overview: An RPG adventure game from the book "Write Your Own Fantasy Games for Your Microcomputer". Deep below the ground lies the dungeons of the ruined castle Crekkan. In it lies the magic idol, stolen from the villagers by an evil wizard. Many adventurers have tried to retrieve this magic idol, but so far, none have returned, except one. Before dying, he told of hoards of monsters and traps. The villagers are getting worried as if the evil wizard returns he will surely use the idol to take over the village. Are you ready to try?

177428.overview: Created with the Pinball Construction Set and published on the PCS Club Disk #06, and in Stonysoft #1729, this pinball simulation was created by CMD, a Swedish PCS club member.

177450.overview:
This is a special SEUCK REDUX version of Delta Run. Featuring enemy aiming functions, and a reduction of SEUCK Slowdown syndrome. Also some slightly redesigned background has been used.

Greetings Pilot. Prepare for the Delta Run ... The Space Pirates have been raiding passers by across the Galaxy. Nowhere is now safe in space. Space Agents have discovered that pirates have built 4 Delta Bases. Two in space, and two on board their planet. The last Delta Base was severly damaged under construction. On each Delta Base, you will be fighting against assorted alien space pirates. Your job is to simply infiltrate them and their guardians. Pick up crystals to score bonus points, gain extra lives or power ups. Can you clear all 4 Delta Bases and leave one final surprise for the Space Pirates? Their fate is in your hands. Good luck!

177454.overview: Created with the Pinball Construction Set by Russco.

177469.overview:
Compilation compiling the first five games in the Dizzy series:

    Dizzy (replaced by Kwik Snax on 16-bit platforms)
    Fast Food
    Treasure Island Dizzy
    Fantasy World Dizzy
    Magicland Dizzy

Fast Food is a Pac-Man style game.

177473.overview: Created using the Pinball Construction Set this was a follow-up and improvement on the first two games in the series and was published in PCS Club Disk #08, and in Stonysoft #1731.

178419.overview:
The scene chosen for this adventure, the first one of the "Ci-U-Than" trilogy, is the Yucatan, a mysterious land in which legends say there are a lot of dangers, hidden treasures, unsolved mysteries, temples filled with traps... in short, the ingredients to which the good adventurer is used to deal with.

The adventure takes place on the island of Cozumel, where you must guide an archaeologist who had an incident. He was sailing towards it perfectly equipped, when an unfortunate shipwreck left him without anything. Do not think he only lost the map or the machete, no, he lost everything, including the trousers and the underclothes, reason why it's quite possible that an entrance in San Marcos, a coastal town near the place of the shipwreck, would carry serious problems with the justice. The main mission of the adventure is to discover all the hidden secrets of the island and then be able to escape from it.

178420.overview:
Des Chiffres et des Lettres ("Numbers and Letters") is a French game show which inspired the similar British programme Countdown. Two players compete in a sequence of rounds challenging language and arithmetic skills. In this version you can turn off either type of rounds, and can have infinite time to think in each round, if you wish.

In letters rounds, an array of 9 letters is chosen by each player alternately choosing either a vowel or a consonant, and players must find the longest possible legitimate word. In numbers rounds, an array of face-down numbers (including 25, 50, 75 and 100 as well as 2 each of 1-10) is presented to the player, who chooses the number of 'large' numbers. A target between 101 and 999 is then generated, and players must get as close to this as possible. Additionally, there are mental arithmetic challenge rounds, in which players must solve an equation as quickly as possible.

178813.overview:
Compilation of 4 games from Durrell Software, the games included are:

•   Combat Lynx
•   Critical Mass
•   Saboteur
•   Turbo Esprit

179266.overview: Help Tonk find the stolen Toy chest in Gork's castle. Pilot him through the spooky garden and into the castle. Collect the keys to open the doors. Beware Gork, if he sees Tonk he will attack with his evil eye. Was later re-released as "Developing Thinking Skills With the Tink Tonks" by Thundermountain

179525.overview: A horizontally-scrolling space shooter published in Commodore 64 Club #07 [Italian Release], Commodore Computer Club Nr.5, Commodore Computer Club Nr.6 [v1], and also in Digital Marketing PD #122. This game purports to be a 3d game using anaglyphic glasses.

179526.overview: Collect the diamonds but you can only carry 20 at a time. Drop them in the bucket when full. Can you get them all before your energy runs out. Each step drains away a tiny bit of energy.

180408.overview: A Lunar Lander type game released under several names, Nuclear Attack, Delta Race and finally Destruction with Robtek. In this game it is the year 3060 and an excavation in the great northern desert has triggered an ancient 20th century nuclear missile. It is due to launch in 5 minutes. In order to detonate the missile and save the earth, you must enter the subterranean silo, negotiate the passages and attach an explosive. Once set, you have 2 minutes to get clear.

181019.overview: In 1993 Merek Roth (Possibly with help from Olaf Roth) released a series of 8 Boulder Dash Remix disks, this being the first.

181120.overview:
Goldenbear took Ikari's crack of Game Over II +, turned the trainer on, edited the sprites and title screen, entered the password then froze it. I've seen this claimed to be a real commercial production that was supplied and cracked in at least four cases even though the evidence of it being a horrible hack is glaringly obvious. Like Abyss' Super Mario Bros +3 this is a modification of an existing game to fit a Super Mario Bros theme. Except where Abyss' production is delightful, the only way this resembles a Mario game is that the player jumps in a similar, but very slow, way. The goombah sprites are off and other sprites have incomplete animations and switch back and forth between their original forms and the edited ones.

Published as Discesa Infernale, in Italy in multiple publications including Game 2000 Nuova serie n.22 (Novembre 1989), Supplementi Edigamma/pubblirome - 30 games esclusivi (1990), Supplementi Edigamma/pubblirome - coin up (1991) and New Games Nuova serie n.3 (Novembre 1992).

181561.overview: 25 new caves in a Boulder Dash adventure! Created by Dan (Boulderdan) Tavernier.

181658.overview: Released on several name, Basic Pinball, Turbo Pinball and David Midnight Magic's Pinball #666, this pinball table, created with the Pinball Construction Set was released in 1995.

182205.overview: Marek Roth\Marek Swiderski took up development of the 1stB engine and packer and created this with his new De Luxe Packer.  20 new caves of fun in this one.

182206.overview: A Boulder Dash game created by Boulder-Didi based on the Space themed graphics set and including a new set of 20 caves.

182236.overview: Created in 2002 by Zoltán Scserbin. The exact same game with different graphics comes under the names Dig Dug Dash 01, Invasion Dash 01, Robot Dash 01 and Auto Dash 01, but is best known by the 2003 naming Golden Boulder - Who Dares Wins 01!

182432.overview: A version of Boulder Dash designed by Marek Roth with 2 caves to enjoy.

182433.overview: A version of Boulder Dash from Marek Swiderski\Marek Roth that contained a new combination of 20 caves.

182614.overview: Created by Marek Roth AKA Marek Swiderski this action puzzle game has 20 caves to defeat.

182615.overview: The fifth in the series, Marek Roth aka Marek Marek Swiderski returns to offer up another 20 caves for your Boulder Dashing pleasure.

182616.overview: Sixth of Eight in the series by Marek Roth aka Marek Swiderski, this offering gave us 20 more caves to plunder and negotiate.

182685.overview: Another Del Luxe Remix from Marek Swiderski aka Marek Roth. 20 new caves for your mining pleasure.

182699.overview: The final game in the Boulder Dash Deluxe Remix series, a last 20 caves to challenge you from Marek Roth aka Marek Marek Swiderski.

182702.overview: Dartz is a computerized version of the popular pub game of well...darts. It was developed by Michael Ware and was published by Argus Specialist Publications Ltd, in Commodore Disk User 1989/03-04 and again in Your Commodore 1991/01 (Tape #13).Your Commodore 1991/01 (Tape #13).

182706.overview: Dave Parker: Wenn sie wüssten was sie tun... is a German language adventure game with selectable answers. It was developed in 1992 by Peter Diehm.

182756.overview: Dawn of the Nasty is a vertically scrolling shooter game with decent music made by Simon J. Reece in 1994 using Chris Yates' SEUCK in 1994. This game has or or two player co-op, you can play with either joystick for one player by pressing the button to play either the characters of Harold or Darren Booth, or play with a second player.

182912.overview: Second in the game trilogy, Marek Roth\Marek Swiderski took up development of the 1stB engine and packer and created this set with his new De Luxe Packer. 20 new caves of fun in this one.

182916.overview: The final game in the De Luxe Dash trilogy, containing 20 new caves from Marek and some interesting special effects.

182930.overview: A remixed version with 20 caves by Posopi Waldkirch.

184787.overview:
Der Verlassene Planet (German for The Abandoned Planet) is a German language graphical text adventure developed in 1989 by Hannes Seifert and publishd by Markt & Technik in 64'er Software Extra Nr.15: Abenteuer-Spiele. 

In the year 1998 you left Earth in a spaceship to investigate an unknown planet. The computer of the spaceship however malfunctions and it returns you to Earth, but on arriving it appears that humanity has self-destructed. However some have survived...

184883.overview:
An action game created by John Bettels and released in Input 64 1986/06. You are in a spaceship with limited energy and oxygen supplies and, after you have picked up at least seven diamonds, you are supposed to find the sunken city. So far so good. Of course, the author has built in some difficulties, but also the possibility to fill up on both energy and oxygen on the way, or simply to be transported from here to there. Keep fueled up and refill your oxygen supply by touching the flashing oxygen tanks. Some locks release themselves at certain intervals, while others have a door opener in front of and behind the lock. If you want to be transported to another section of the game without stress, you should (as always from above) drive onto the large box. If you're unlucky, you'll come out in the same place. 

If you have collected enough diamonds and nothing has fallen on your head along the way, you can remove the last barrier with the fire key (space bar) when you reach the city (it must be somewhere). The game ends when you drive towards a house. We wish you a steady hand (some passages are really narrow) and a lot of fun on the journey of discovery.

186441.overview:
Digiloi, an all-PETSCII action game by Dr. TerrorZ.
A computer weapons ecosystem is about to take over the whole planet. You need to disable the master computer by finding three floppy keys and insert them in the terminal.
Jump, run and fire with joystick in port 2. Turn up to enter doorways.

Music/FX options.
The d64 includes a bonus color-enhanced Commodore Plus/4 version which sadly only has sound if you have a SID card at $fd40.

The game was released as part of K&A Plus #12.

186581.overview: The Dark Forest is a text adventure with RPG elements developed by Clive Gifford and Robert Young. It was published as a type-in program in their book Creating Adventures on Your Commodore 64 by Interface Publications in 1984. Gather your wits and take great care of your strength. You can type "r" to rest at any time. If you run out of strength your game will end. Can you conquer The Dark Forest, outwit your enemies, explore the forest and find and beat The Creature. If you can rid the country of a great threat you shall be well rewarded.

186911.overview: In this BASIC coded free public domain game, you are the owner and operator of a donut shop. Your goal is to sell as many donuts as possible within a five day period, by setting prices of your donuts, choosing the quantity to make within the day, etc.

187759.overview:
Die Ringe von Coplar (translates to the The Rings of Coplar) is a German language text adventure game developed by Sebastian Begaße & Georg Rottensteiner and released to the public domain in 2014.

There was a short lived physical release version in Germany as well.

187764.overview:
Diamond Drop is a  variation of the old Atari Arcade game Avalanche. It is keyboard controlled only. This game was developed by Eric Brandon and published by COMPUTE! Publicatins, Inc. in COMPUTE! 1983/09 (Issue #40), as well as COMPUTE!'s First Book of C64 Games

It was also released by Alpha Software Ltd. and released in Europe under the name Collection Day and published as part of "The Big One" Collection. 

Also released in Norway under the name Diamant Slipp by Data-Tronic

189651.overview:
Destroy All Robots X21 is a 2011 vertically scrolling shooter in a maze-like setting. It was developed by Roberto Ricioppo (also known as Robric)  using Chris Yates SEUCK engine.

Robots are invading your planet. It's time to get rid of them :)

190658.overview:
Set in a post-apocalyptic New York, Double Dragon is the story of Billy and Jimmy Lee, twin brothers trained in the fighting style of Sou-Setsu-Ken. Together, they manage a small martial arts training school, teaching their students in self-defense. One day, Billy's girlfriend, Marian, is kidnapped off the street by the "Black Warriors", a savage street gang led by a man named Willy. The Black Warriors demand the Lee brothers disclose their martial arts secrets in exchange for Marian's freedom. The Lee brothers set out on a rescue mission to crush the Black Warriors and save Marian.

Using whatever techniques they have at their disposal, from the basic punches and kicks to the invulnerable elbow strike, as well any weapon that comes into their hands, the Lee brothers must pursue the gang through the city slum, industrial area and the forest before reaching their hideout to confront the big boss, Willy.

This is the Ocean version from 1992. Unlike the Virgin/Melbourne House version from 1987, this version only supports one player as it was originally designed for the failed C64GS games console.

192737.overview: Dragon Type is a typing tutor/typing game with a medieval fantasy theme for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Bob Spirko and published by Ion  International, Inc. in Ahoy! 1985/09 (Issue #21)

193147.overview:
Just in time for Halloween 2020 comes Death Saw Challenge...

You play the role of Fuzzi, a cute blue creature. You have been thrown into a deadly dungeon. You are not alone. You have company ... Aah, how nice and wonderful ... Well, it is not really that nice. Death saws appear from nowhere and they are out to get you.

Your task is to guide Fuzzi around the dungeon and help him survive for as long as he can before getting diced up by a death saw. Before a saw appears an alarm will alert you. Every time a saw appears, you are automatically protected for a few seconds. Staying idle will not award you any points and gives you a higher risk of death. So don't be idle. YOU MUST MOVE OUT THE WAY AS QUICK AS POSSIBLE.

The game will start easy with 1 death saw per 15 seconds. Then 15 seconds after 7 death saws appear ... Ooer!!!

How long can you survive the DEATH SAW CHALLENGE!?!?!

194271.overview: You need to free Melissa, she has knowledge for you but not yet. Gather the clues to find her and in part 2 you may be able to escape from Tarnie. Be vigilant, you may have to fight with rogues any minute!

195025.overview: Damn funny shoot em up. Quite fun. Very similar to the game released as Sea Ranger but with significantly altered graphics, giving Das Sub a much larger playing area and better graphics.

195491.overview:
Not to be confused with Duel by Pioneer Software, Duell is the other C64 game about jousting while riding an ostrich.

The game is for 2-4 players. It was developed by Ralph Jordan and published in 64'er 1987/09.

195696.overview: The age old board game of Checkers or Droughts. Published in COMPUTE! 1983/05 (Issue #36) and as a game of "The Big 100" collection.

196678.overview: Diffuser is a a game in which the goal is to diffuse bombs set by terrorists. It was developed by Mike Fleischner and released into the public domain. The year of release is currently unknown.

196900.overview: BrainWave is a free puzzle game inspired by Mahjong tile removal games, the main difference being the setting and the design of the pieces. it was released in Italy under several names including Double Box, Pezzo Doppio and Piramix.

197220.overview: An updated/improved version of the Domino Logic game that came on Loadstar #61. This one was released ten years later on Loadstar #175. Both versions were developed by Dave Johannsen. An ingenious but updated random puzzle that dares you to divide a grid of dots into dominoes. Multiple level selections allow you to make this as easy or difficult as you want. Joystick and keyboard controls, color and font controls and an undo command round out the features. The new version allows it to work from any drive, having it all in one file, and updated and improved font selections.

197224.overview: Domino Run is a gambling game for 1-4 players. It was developed by Bob Mockford and released into the public domain in 1985.

197227.overview: Doof is a side-scrolling shooter developed by Fabian Del Priore using Garry Kitchen's GameMaker and released into the public domain in 1990.

197371.overview: Das Drachental (translates to The Dragon Valley) is a German language fantasy genre text and graphics adventure published in Abenteuer-Paket 2 game pack along with Flucht ins Paradies (Escape to Paradise).

197722.overview: 1918 - with Europe a bloody battleground, Germany's Red Baron and his squadron of aerial aces rule the skies! With the allied armies in disarray, the only hope for England and France lies in the skill of a young American flyer determined to cripple the Baron's legions. That flyer is you!

198078.overview:
A Day in the life of our mega-star.
 
Find all your friends so they can come to your rave.
 
Good luck!
Published by Champion Software and in Italy as Mister Egg in Tutto C64 n.2 (1992/1993).

198432.overview: Division Tic Tac Toe is a math based Tic Tac Toe game that revolves around division. It is a conversion of an old Commodore Plus/4 game. The conversion was done by Barry "Cout" Hart in 2017.

198464.overview: Guide your space ship safely across Dreider 6. Fight the enemies, and win the great space war. Created by Roberto Ricioppo using Chris Yates' Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit, and released into the public domain (via TND) in 2015.

199416.overview: When the people began to drain the swamp, the swamp spirits made their escape to a unknown world  with the only available magic vacuum cleaner, but a swamp spirit has swallowed up the departure and must be dealt with. Also published in Power-Games (Bestell-Nr. 38785).

199522.overview: Indulge your opponents, the favorite pastime of testy cowboys: the merciless duel. A game for two players only. Created by Gérard Limbard and published in Hebdogiciel Hors Serie N°2, and Hebdogiciel Software N°5.

199871.overview:
A scientist has been captured by a villainous tyrant who is now trying to force him to make gold for him. The main hero of the adventure, i.e. the player, actually stumbles into this story by accident. But as it should be for an adventurer and hero, this challenge is of course accepted.

Will it be possible to obtain the Philosopher's Stone, that mystical elixir that can turn everything into gold?

And if so, what will happen then?

199954.overview: Deathship is a text based adventure game written in BASIC, like most Aardvark adventure games were. This one was unique in that it was sold as a tutorial; if you ordered it, you got the game itself, as well as a 14 page datasheet of detailed instructions on how to write adventures, and how Deathship in particular was set up.

201558.overview:
The alien fleet commanded by General Jhon Benson is doing everything to invade the earth. Fortunately, we earthlings have a deadly weapon, an exceptional laser cannon that you will have to maneuver using your joystick controls. The aliens are very numerous so it all comes down to your ability to eliminate them. Pay special attention to the multicolored spaceships which are among the most dangerous. 

Published as Death Star in Italy's Nova Games n.31 (Maggio 1989).

203622.overview:
A Italian shooter set in the first Gulf War, fight your way past the Iraqi Republican Guard, destroy the Scud missile launchers and eventually take your fight all the way to Saddam Hussein himself in this SEUCK based military shooter. 

Released in The Sea Software Collection.

203624.overview: A side-view shooter set underwater and created by Karl-Johan Nilsson using the Shoot'em Up Construction Kit.

203626.overview: A shooter created using the Shoot'em Up Construction Kit by Philip Bayliss and released by Binary Zone PD to the public domain.

203627.overview:
Released in Stonysoft #0104, Stonysoft-PD #0519 and in Italy in the  Byte Games n.24 (ottobre 1988) compilation. 

As the legend goes, there was a great and brave King, ruler of all the lands of the North who at the moment of his marriage with the princess of the South was transformed into a dragon by a jealous magician. To break the spell you will have to wander the immense lands of the west and find some precious gems, which is not an easy task as you will have to deal with numerous, fearsome monsters.

204135.overview: A German language Educational game focusing on spelling.

205432.overview: A German language steam engine simulation published in Europa Computer-Club 750 022.0 in 1985.

205437.overview: Dual Block Drop is a 1-2 player vs. Tetris clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Canadian programmer Norman Yen, and released into the public domain in 1990.

205444.overview: Digit Fidget is a mathematical puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed in 1990 by Penny DeGroff and published in Loadstar #076.

205549.overview:
Daten-Agent 00X is a German language adventure game for the Commodore 64. It seems to be based on the "007" formula, based on the title screen. 

It was developed by Hans-Werner Müller and published by Markt & Technik in 64'er Sonderheft 85.

205792.overview: Davok is a strangle little arcade adventure game released only in Italy. It was released in Commodore 64 Club #10 [Italian Release] in 1989. The actual developer is unknown.

206669.overview:
An Action game by Steve Stiglich published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1984/11 (Issue #17). Gliding asteroids and a layer of clouds separate you from your supply base on 
Planet Kaylon. Is safe passage possible? For the VIC and 64.  
 
Cruising over Planet Kaylon in your spaceship, you spot a supply base below. But as soon as you send off a shuttle ship to the base, a cluster of asteroids sails across its path. Darting quickly through the asteroids and clouds, your shuttle narrowly escapes collision before touching down on Kaylon,

207131.overview:
The special Christmas release of the award winning Doc Cosmos contains some graphical updates to make Doc more seasonal along with 5 additional puzzling screens not found in the original game (and some minor bug fixes to fill out the stocking).  
 
Doc Xmas is on the very, very familiar search for a powerful alien device that is rumored to be able to allow the user to time travel. He arrives on the snowy alien planet to begin his quest to obtain the device but soon gets stuck in the underground complex.  
 
Use the device to switch between timelines (and control schemes)!

207284.overview: David Powell's Sex Quest is an adult themed text adventure in which you play the titular character of David Powell in his quest to lose his virginity. The game's developer is unknown, as is the year of release.

207293.overview:
Donald's Snow Fight is a game for the C64 that is inspired by the 1942 Disney short cartoon of the same name. It was developed by retrogamer1975 and released to the public domain in 2020.

Story:

Donald needs a bouquet of roses for his date with Daisy. His nephews have seven red roses but won't give it to him. They have hidden them in their seven snow castles and to get them Donald needs to beat them in snowball fighting.

207313.overview:
Dice Skater is an action game with puzzle elements. You play a little guy on a single dice (or an average sized guy on a gigantic oversized disc, depending on your perspective). The goal is to color in all the dots on the dice. There is also a little dot that follows you around that you have to avoid.

The game was developed by Geir Straume with music by Sean Connolly and released as part of the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2019

207339.overview: Dark Tower is a simple role-playing game in the German language developed by Robert Valentiner and published in 64'er Sonderheft 1985/03. Dark Tower or Dark Tower: Adventures in Three Rivers is a German-language adventure with the task of freeing the scenically so beautiful Dreistromland from the reign of terror of evil and thus redeeming the downtrodden population.

207368.overview: Denture Warrior: The War of Corega is a strange little platformer from Germany for the Commodore 63. It was debeloped by Elmar Denkmann and published by Mania-Soft in 1985.

207372.overview: Desert War is a 1-2 player (co-op) vertically scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Keith Killilea using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit, and released ino the public domain in 1997.

208396.overview: The Dungeons of Mulgoolie is an adventure game with RPG elements for the Commodore 64 home computer.  It was developed by Kevin B. Joella and released into the public domain in 1985.

208571.overview: Another treat from the Belgian bombshell, called No One, for your spelunking delight. A set of 20 caves using the PLCK Boulder Dash engine created by different makers and compiled by No One with a special twist which allowed a surprise effect: Every time you play, the caves are different. Over a million different variations of play!! Originally published in 1987 and then updated and re-released in late 1988. The game was originally released in 2 parts, but eventually at least 24 were part of the Delight series.

208580.overview: Another treat from the Belgian Basehead, No One. This time another 20 caves with a randomizer that puts the levels in an unexpected order and you can change the type of foes and obstacles to delight you. Over a million combinations can be had! Originally released in 1987 and re-released on August 7, 1988. Created using the PLCK version of the Construction Kit and caves from several different (mostly Belgian) makers. Every time you play it will be different.

208598.overview: A shooter by TheReaperUK & Richard Bayliss by way of the Shoot'em Up Construction Kit. Arcade Style Fake 2.5D Sideways Heli-Copter Shoot 'em' up.

208599.overview:
In this game the evil genie Khezam is building an ARMY OF THE DEAD to conquer the earth. Travelling around the world on his flying carpet, he has now arrivedthe northern parts of Norway, where he intend to wake up the soul of a blood thirsty viking warrior. By bombing holes in the ground he will set his spirit free. Little does he know that the gravekeeper Docster is having his night shift on the cemetary. Armed with a shovel, Docster is ready to fight evil!

Use a joystick in port 2 to move Docster around the cemetary. Press the fire button to fill in the holes before the dead viking come crawling up out of them.

Good luck, you will need it!
Released as a bonus game with "Mancave"

208604.overview:
1 Player arcade shoot em up, Fly the Dragon over the lands of Kof, Shoot everything you see, shoot eggs for Power ups, But be careful at the Maze of Vines, Touch the Vines and you Lose a Life, Good Luck and have Fun.

Made with help from the Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software and Using a modified SEUCK Enhancement Framework code, The music was done by Andrew Fisher.

208620.overview: A one player joust-like game created by Chris Page & Brent Page for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition and later released as an extended play edition.

208621.overview:
A Spectrum conversion done by the author, John "Zenobi" Wilson, himself. 

Our story begins in London, 1868: where deep in the faceless labyrinth, Dr.
Henry Jekyll - a wealthy medical scientist seemingly overlooked by history - is
approaching the very culmination of his work into the nature of the human
psyche. Long years he has groped, innocent of his danger, towards a discovery
that threatens the sanctity of the mind itself - threatens YOU with the reality
of its disaster. Now he approaches the final reckoning. The theory is sound, the
reagents are known. It but remains to put them to the test ......

208622.overview: Garnering 2nd place at the C64 Game Competition at BCC Party #14, this game has you in the chair of Daniel, karate student of Mr Miyagi, after a day of waxing and painting just trying to enjoy a bowl of noodles. However, Mr. Miyagi doesn't have air conditioning and you must keep the flies away from the bowl. You need to use your chopsticks to stop flies from getting into Mr Miyagi's broth. Failure to do this three times and you'll be quickly forced out into the garden to perform another mind numbing task of painting the fence.

208639.overview:
Welcome to the Dungeon of ROTT, Watch out for Monsters, Keep an Eye out for Traps and Treasure. 

Made with help from the Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software, Music by Andrew Fisher, and Using my modified SEUCK Enhancement Framework Code, Original Framework code by Richard Bayliss of TND.

208949.overview: The game, created by Mark Gallagher, Ed Campbell and Andrew Rodger, is fairly simple, and has you controlling Drax, who has to kick and destroy various small creatures across a horizontally bi-directionally scrolling game screen. Remeniscent of Chameleon by Electric Dreams in some ways. The early version looks pretty dated, but its the remixed edition which really starts looking very nice indeed.

209061.overview:
An Italian game by Marco Mietta and published in Commodore 64 Club #04 [Italian Release] in 1988. And here we are in the world of medieval knights and their chivalrous deeds. In this adventure game the protagonist must in fact compete in tournaments on horseback that often take place among the noble warriors. To do this he must obviously prepare himself in time and in an adequate way for his mission. In the weaponsmith's shop you can choose between various types of swords, shields and helmets, which have different performance and costs, or you can reinforce your armor at will, all compatibly with the money you have... 
 
The tournaments take place every two, three or four days, and different groups of riders take part in them. Logically, against the strongest opponents you have less chances of victory, but if you manage to defeat them you get higher cash prizes and also, if you have shown particular courage, the possibility of measuring yourself against the King to usurp his kingdom. ambition of each knight and event that represents the victory of the game.

209255.overview: In the game made with SEUCK (Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit) you control the hero entered the evil land. You should break through the Land of Fire, Dragon Valley, Demons` Realm, and Final Stage shooting the enemies with throwing axes, avoiding their attacks, and collecting the crucifixes. During your perilous travel enemy magic lamps, guns, coffins, and various kinds of demons will try to eliminate you. So you should eliminate your opponents and gain scores. Some of the demons should be eliminated by parts. Published in Italy in Commodore 64 Club #10 [Italian Release].

209257.overview:
This game was made with SEUCK (Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit). As the pilot of an assault fighter, you should fly over the hostile territory presented in a scrolling top-down view. Starting over the sea, you will travel through different places such as fortified roads, airfields, green plantations, etc. During your perilous flight enemy helicopters, planes, cars, and fixed guns will try to eliminate you, so you should eliminate your opponents and gain points. 
 
Released in both Commodore Computer Club Nr.4, and in Stonysoft #0404.

209607.overview:
It is a time of darkness. While the Sultan is off fighting a foreign war, his Grand Vizier Jaffar has seized the reins of power. Throughout the land, the people groan under the yoke of tyranny, and dream of better days. You are the only obstacle between Jaffar and the throne. An adventurer from a foreign land, innocent of palace intrigues, you have won the heart of the Sultan's lovely daughter. And in so doing, you have unwittingly made a powerful enemy. On Jaffar's orders, you are arrested, stripped of your sword and possessions, and thrown into the Sultan's dungeons.

The Doomed Prince of Persia is a Custom set of level based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. This mod was originally created for the Dos version by Nicholas Normand, and converted to the C64 by Starwindz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack.

210245.overview: Released as part of the Demozoo C64 4kb Game Coding Competition 2020 - Demozoo by James. Collect the dots to open the door to the next level. Fire to jump and push off of walls. Pushing fire while in the aire will boost the player in the direction they are facing. Only one boost can be used until the player lands.

210265.overview:
After quite a few months of work, The Dragon's Castle, the last title of Sputnik World, a game that transports us to a world of medieval fantasy, with heroes, dragons, a couple of dice and all the intention to flood with fun in front of your C64, having a good time and enjoying a new adventure. Open the doors of the castle with the sharp sword and blow the dice, which begins our journey to the treasures that hides our odyssey.  
 
The game is based on the original that Álvaro Ibañez published in Commodore World magazine in February 1987, in his number 34. Its beginning follows the attempt at its preservation that originated in 2013 in a debate at the Commodore forum for its recovery. It has been reworked and rewritten in assembly. Available worldwide in both Spanish and English.

210655.overview: Dual 1024 is a stay on the track style racing game created by Darren Hatch for the Minigame Competition 2002.

210661.overview: Over 20 levels of fast and furious arcade action, interlinked by an ingenious bonus section, making this one of the most addictive games you'll ever play. Fly over the surface of the planet in your battle-armoured jet suit, finding off attacks by enemy aircraft and guided missiles, while avoiding the deadly landscape features. At the end of each level you'll be confronted by a gigantic mothership, invulnerable to normal lasers. So shoot the asteroids that are flying over the planet to reveal crystals. Once you've collected the crystals they can be used against the mothership. If successful a friendly alien will transport you to the next stage, during this journey you must hit the red energy orb to keep it in front of you.

210690.overview: The Day the Lights Stayed Out is a text adventure developed by Mark Le-May using the Graphic Adventure Creator. Despite this, it's a standard text adventure without graphics. The game was released into the public domain in 1986.

213281.overview:
DELVE! is a procedurally-generated action rogue-like with a tiny smattering of Eye of the Beholder (if the Beholder was a pack of nasty goblins). 
 
QUICK-START (haha!) INSTRUCTIONS
Hunt your prey through the dungeon by using:

W = step forward/attack a goblin directly in front of you
A = strafe one step left
S = step backwards
D = strafe one step right
Q = rotate 90 degrees left
E = rotate 90 degrees right 
 
IMPORTANT!: When you arrive on a new level you automatically drop a special GROUNDING BOTTLE that you will then later pick up (well, walk in to, as you cant move the BOTTLE) to instantly teleport you to the next level. Unfortunately, due to poor planning on your part, it looks exactly like all of the other potion bottles scattered around the dungeon.

You can only activate the GROUNDING BOTTLE once you've taken care of at least HALF of the goblins on the current level. You'll know when you can use the BOTTLE as you'll see your portrait shouting a battle cry when he thins out the evil denizens of a level. (You've remembered how to get back to the room you started in where the BOTTLE is, right?)

BEWARE!: The GROUNDING BOTTLE will be destroyed if you kill a goblin while it's standing over the BOTTLE, leaving you trapped forever!! (Or just hit Return to restart)

213328.overview: A battle dice RPG for the C64 in less than 4096 bytes. Although Dicing With Death 4kb was originally created for the Reset64 Craptastic4k competition, they ended up being a few days late to the deadline but has still decided to release it anyway for all to enjoy!

213381.overview: Dice Game is well, a public domain simulation of a casino dice game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Carl M. Lockman, however the release year is currently unknown.

213382.overview: Dice8 is a public domain dice game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Alan Petrik & Petr Chlud on December 31, 2018. A new version was released on July 2, 2022.

213726.overview: Diamond Hunter is an arcade collect 'em up for r 2 player only (simultaneous competitive) for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Percy Peter and published in Magic Disk 64  1989/07.

214974.overview:
A cooperative space-invaders style shooter for two simultaneous players. The game was created by Hannes Sommer from Klagenfurt, Austria and released in both 64'er 1991/03 and later in 64'er Sonderheft 79. In this space game, one or two players can maneuver their the dark universe. But suddenly you are faced with a wild attacker. He hides not only cowardly behind a protective galacto-wall. but also fires solar torpedoes. How fortunate that you have taken precautions and that your spaceship is equipped with a powerful laser.
If, contrary to expectations, you succeed in shooting down all the torpedoes, you are by no means saved. No, because the wall is getting closer and your opponent fires another salvo off, but this time at a higher speed. Only after playing through and surviving four levels do you get a bonus level. If, on the other hand, everyone is gone, F1 or F2 starts the game again for one or two players. Have fun and good luck.

214976.overview:
These are the words of Lo'ana, the Deedspeaker, a precious telling of the events leading to the Queen's arrival:

Once, in a time before any living man remembers, a King, strong of spirit but weak of body, died without an heir. Most people thought this was the end of the Darkwoodrealm, but a prophet, called Antetime, the One Always Here, spake of a woman that would come from a world away and lead Darkwood from ruin. Many years passed waiting for the woman, and the realm-dwellers began to doubt the prophesy. Foolish men! For she came, assisted by an experience-young cleric. Many questioned the necessity of the cleric, but the Queen, called Yannah by the realm-dwellers but Didi to those she was fond of, would hear no doubts. The cleric had saved her life, she said, and had always been a loyal friend. She would not abandon the cleric now.

Nor did she, for the cleric proved wise and well able to rule the realm in the company of the Queen, banishing all question of necessity. All was
well. Together, they lead Darkwood to rebirth.

So goes the song of Lo'ana. But it is not the end of the song, for forces began again to dwell in Darkwood, affecting the dwellers of Darkwood Castle in different ways. The queen, Didi, began to walk in her sleep, crying the name Kas, and the cleric soon after suffered unsought trips into the Dream-estate, returning sweat-soaked and memory-less, knowing only that a battle would soon be fought and won. So be it.

Originally listed here with a 1988 date. The text adventure was uploaded to Q-Link in 1986, according to the 1988 Public Domain QLink Software Catalogue. 
Version 2 of the game is dated 1988.

214978.overview: An obscure French maze adventure game that had some corrupted image files in most releases. An English translation and fix was created by .mad. in 2021. Work your way through the maze using the items at hand to fight the monsters that block your way. At the end, a Minotaur awaits you. Put him in the grave to be finally free.

214981.overview: An English and German language brain game created by Assassin and Willow with music by Toni Hilpinen & Ringo Reuter. Released to the public domain in 1997.  The aim of the game is to guess five letter words. After the game starts you'll see the first letter on the upper left cell. Now you should complete the word by filling in the other cells. Just like mastermind, letters who are in the searched word turn cyan. If a letter is also at the correct place, it will stay there for following rows. For every incorrect attempt, you get less points in the end. Additionally, for every turn you have just 15 seconds. If you can't get it in five tries you will lose one of your two lives and the yin\yang symbols on the upper screen will shrink.

214982.overview:
The game was pretty much a clone of Defender with knobs on – with some impressive parallax scrolling (similar to Sanxion in some respects), a neat ship and cool end of level guardians. A preview managed to sneak out many moons ago, which consists of 3 levels, with no attack waves, just a few crafts and end baddies. There is also no sound present.

The preview though was much older than you might think, and was developed in the mid-late 1980s. The original developers were Ian and Martin (Known more as ‘God and Hake’) and were good friends of Russ. They had ditched the game before moving onto fully fledged commercial projects such as ‘Galdregons Domain’ and ‘Volfield’. When EBES became a company back in 1994, EBES’ Russ Michaels dug it out and planned to enhance the game with his team of programmers.

However, it was planned to be a release that required a CMD RAMLINK, allowing instant loading, video cutscenes and large animated sequences. The graphics were to be more colourful and defined, more animation and ultra smooth scrolling. These were the features mentioned in Commodore Format at least. It is likely that a cutdown version would have been done for those without a RAMLINK.

The support for the C64 was decaying badly, and no-one was buying the hardware that Russ was importing. Things also became difficult at EBES, with most of the development team leaving Russ by himself.

Russ took the game on briefly, messed around briefly, but that was it. As Commodore World was being imported into in the UK by EBES as part of its many ventures (this to save the magazine readership in the UK), Russ asked readers to let him know if they wanted to support Defensive. No response was given at all, so the game was axed for good.

215075.overview: A Pac-Man Style game created by Geir Straume  for the Minigame Competition 2002 for games created in 1K.

215077.overview: A patience style solitaire game created by Ewen Gillies and published in 1996 as part of a special Shinjitsu Software Disk by Commodore Scene. The author really wanted something with great music and fun and strange effects to mirror some of the things seen on PC card games at the time.

215078.overview:
Your quest is to enter the dungeon and retrieve the sacred Arkenstone. You will be rewarded greatly, if you survive...  
 
An adventure game created by Britt Froemel in 1987, considered a text based RPG.

215089.overview:
A selectable answers adventure game based on the wildly successful Italian Dylan Dog series. While this was very popular for the Amiga, that didn't turn out to be true for the C64. Versions are available for both English and Italian language. Based on the Italian comics character Dylan Dog, London "nightmare detective", Le Notti della Luna Piena (The Full Moon Nights) is a volume #3 created by Tiziano Sclavi himself and is an interactive-fiction adventure with graphics in comics art-style.

One day mister Price came to your office and told you about disappearance of his daughter, Mary Ann. She lived in Germany in old strict college, where only rich girls are educated. You are asked to find her and to take her back to London. The reward for this job is 5,000 pounds.

So, at the very beginning of the game, you find yourself (accompanied by your butler Groucho) driving Volkswagen in the German land under a torrential rain in the evening. During the following investigation you will meet different persons, explore the different places, encounter the werewolves, be able to avoid the situations lethal for you, bu not for others, and finally find out, who stands behind the disappearances of the girls in the woods around the Wolfsburg, Germany.

The gameplay includes reading the text describing the situation, examining the picture, and choosing your next action amongst 2 or 3 possible selections.

215342.overview: Released in 1990 by Markt & Technik/64'er and created by Wolfgang Ring, published in 64'er Sonderheft 60. Find the pharaoh's tomb in the dark catacombs of the Cheops Pyramid. Where is the king's legendary death mask?

215343.overview: Das Geheimnis der Pyramiden or The Mystery of the Pyramids is a public domain text adventure game with selectable answers created by Karlheinz Herpel and released in Digital Marketing PD #157 and in 64´er - 78 Paradize.

215970.overview:
A German language "complete" chess program aka Profi Chess released in 1987 by Falken Verlag GmbH and Ariolasoft. "Das komplette Schach-programm" was developed with the intention of taking chess programming into a new direction. It is designed not only for the beginner, who would like to play against an appropriate chess partner, but also for the hobby player, who wants to systematically increase his play strength and become acquainted with the reasons behind the play. Also, the advanced amateur, who would like to sharpen his training on combinations, finds an instructor, with an ideal game interference with many options in the open structure of the program.

In the "Spielen" (Play) section, heavy emphasis is made on opening variations that can be practiced, by allowing the player to study the opening library that is available on the disk. In the program section " Trainieren" (Training) short lessons are available to the user, as well as stored diagram test positions all created to increase your chess knowledge, in all three stages of the game -- Opening, middle and endgame.

The program plays strictly according to the international chess rules, possesses a problem solving function, which solves up to mate-in-nine chess problems. A “Save Game” is also available and the program recognizes and names the twenty most important chess openings.

216445.overview:
Earth is yet again under threat by an group of hostile aliens. Your mission is to fly into the doors of space, and wipe them out.

Developed by Roberto Riccioppo using Chris Yates' SEUCK engine in 2012. Music by Richard Bayliss.

216471.overview: The Realm of the Dead in English, this is an unreleased, but fully playable 2D RPG adventure game from Michael Härtig that was created in 1994. Your player character gets four different properties. These are strength and dexterity with weapons, endurance when moving and humor for dealing with the king's daughter. You can have a maximum of 15 points for each of these characteristics. Initially you have 7 points and develop from there.

216824.overview: Accept the challenge, overcome the jumps to be the best! Avoid the other skydivers, grab the balloons and press space to open your parachute before the time gets to zero. At zero you meet the ground! A 2018 game from Igor Errazkin, Darro99 and Esteban Palladino.

217621.overview:
Duck Hunt is a faithful port of the classic Nintendo Entertainment System game of the same name for the Commodore 64. Supports joystick, mouse and the Magnum Light Phaser.

Like the NES version, this contains both 1 duck and 2 ducks modes.

This version was developed by Mahha Mahna and released into the public domain on December 3, 2022.

217682.overview:
This is a shoot 'em up in which you must guide your starship, Diamond through several enemy bases and do battle against the aliens. Stored on some of the alien bases are green pods. Pick those up for extra points. Extra lives are awarded for every 10,000 points scored.

There might be an updated version later on, featuring a loading picture by Fabs. If this is the case, then this download will be replaced with the loading bitmap version

Created by Pinov Vox using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit and released on both TND and the developer's own itch.io page on August 2, 2022.

217750.overview:
Dragon is a German language role-playing game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by AWO-Software and published in CPU 1984/06. The game "Dragon" is a a role playing game that is something of a guessing game which, in addition to a cool head, also requires a willingness to take risks and sometimes strong nerves. The game is played with a joystick, but the program can easily be rewritten for the keyboard.  
 
The program develops a labyrinth in which the Wyrm is in an unknown position. This can now move around on the screen, whereby the labyrinth is gradually displayed and thus explored. With each step, the score is reduced by 5. The aim of the game is to find a dragon that is hiding somewhere without running into its arms or falling into a pitfall. Dragons and pitfalls are indicated in advance by red items or blue items so that the player can avoid them. The player can kill the dragon by pressing the fire button and then indicating the direction, but only if it is directly in front of the dragon's lair. If the player succeeds, he can be enshrined in the circle of the "Dragon Knights of the Round Table to retire" or face the challenge and shoot a new dragon with increased difficulty and dragons "eaten". more points. However, access to the high score table is only possible when the last dragon successfully killed!

218711.overview: Demon Fight is a 1-2 player cooperative shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Massoft Ltd. (Massimiliano"Maxx" Pacchiano) using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit, and released into the public domain in 1991.

218743.overview: Dome Base 64 is a side scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by The Reaper UK using the Sideways Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and released on his itch.io page in 2020.

218788.overview: Der Flipperkoenig is a 1-4 player German language pinball game for the Commodore 64. It was partially developed using the Pinball Construction Kit, but had some additional code added after. The game was developed by Hannes Malecki and published by Welle:Erdball in 2014.

219125.overview:
You play the role of Sam Boon, an L.A. Private Detective. Ask anyone around here and they will have heard of you, however, most of them will question if you are still in business. Times have been hard the last 10 years, cases are fewer, pay less, and mostly involve finding lost cats. 

That is about to change, just as you are wondering where your next case will come from fate intervenes in the form of gunfire.

219158.overview: TheRealWanderer and the rest of the Protovision team presents the Forum64 & Protovision Game Competition 2017.

219793.overview: A PD horizontally scrolling shooter created by Derya Kilicli and released in 1992.

219813.overview:
The Daring Rescue of Pacuvia the Sheep is a short, bizarre, traditional interactive fiction game for C64, Amiga, MS-Dos, Windows and Tandy Model 100. But it's also something more, it's a - drumroll - sentimental research project!

Your character is an operative of a mysterious “Agency”, on a dangerous mission: rescuing the bioengineered sheep called Pacuvia from the clutches of a guy too idiot to understand what he's got. Strapped of all your digital support for security reasons, you'll have to rely on your good ol' analogic equipment to recover Pacuvia. And don't forget she's not necessarily helpless...

219834.overview:
1 Player Shoot Everything Car Game in Fake 2.5D, Avoid Holes in the Road and Barrier's.

Made with the Sideways Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software and Jon Wells, Also New V3 SEUCK Framework by Richard Bayliss.

219835.overview: Designasaurus is an educational simulation game set in the far future. It enables the player to create (build) custom dinosaurs and then walk (control) them through all five ecosystems

219839.overview: Digger is a simplistic game to understand but with ever increasing challenges as the levels progress. The gameplay revolves around your character who must dig around each game area, collecting diamonds and dropped money bags while also trying to avoid the enemy which is wondering around trying to get you

219869.overview: Dungeon Crawl is a simplified maze RPG game similar to rogue-like RPGs, except that in Dungeon Crawl the dungeon is always the same and not randomly generated. To make progress through the dungeon and reach the next dungeon levels, the player has to find keys to unlock doors and find buttons which opens up formerly inaccessible sections. Typical fantasy monsters roam the dungeon, often blocking your path. Killing them gives XP, which is needed to further improve your characters attack and defense values.

219966.overview:
A C64 port of the Game & Watch version of Donkey Kong Junior, as a first project dipping my toes into the waters of 6502 assembler.

Avoid the snappers and birds to reach the key and free Donkey Kong.  Jump to the fruit to drop it on enemies.

219968.overview: A fun way to improve spelling skills. Includes 168 sets of words. Parents and teachers may add additional word lists to the game.

220127.overview:
Dagon’s Awakening by Vintage Computing Carinththia was released physically in the limited edition Underwater Collection - Deluxe LED&Sound Cartridge. It had its first debut at Vintage Computing Carinthia $1F.  
 
In this game, you take on the role of a member of the Esoteric Order of Dagon who is on his way to perform a ritual to awaken Dagon, a giant ancient with a visage enough to drive mortals insane.

The setting is inspired by the stories of H.P. Lovecraft and the game has several endings. Enjoy!

220150.overview: 1 Player Arcade Style Push Scroll Shoot 'em Up, This time you are the Alien, Shoot Electric Acid Spit at the Humans and Gun Turrets, Walk into the Alien Eggs to save them.

228256.overview: Controlling a fan, you need to blow the bubbles up and prevent them from bursting! Of course, the fan needs energy to work and needs to be recharged often by moving it to the sides of the screen.

417858.overview: A 2D adventure RPG created by Eckhard Borkiet and published in 2010 by Eway10 Software and in C64 Retro Line Games No.06 / Digital Talk #096 (24.12.2012).

417860.overview:
A German language commercial text adventure homebrew released in 2009 by Eway10 Software and in C64 Retro Line Games No.05 and in Digital Talk #091 (15.03.2011). It was based in the H.P. Lovecraft world. We naturally became aware that this strange figure emerged at Miscatonic University in Arkham's Miscatonic University and demanded viewing the Necronomicon, a book full of demonology and unspeakable rites. He became very indignant when he was not handed over this forbidden book.

"Cthulhu will punish you," he shall have called after the librarian and disappeared. For years we have been researching the occult, supernatural and evil here in the area and with such "special" requests, we are immediately notified and go to the bottom of the matter.

My research revealed that this man had a relic, also called "The Eye of Dagon," and was apparently on a strange mission. I followed the trail of the stranger to the dark mountains on the Miscatonic River. The snake's pass, also a place of idol worship, would most likely be his goal...

In your search for the man and his strange relic, you go to a remote village that does not necessarily receive you with its inhabitants. Explore the village and its inhabitants. Stay and find the eye of Dagons.

417878.overview: A ROM Hack of the text adventure game Valley of Treasures by Uka translating the game into Polish in 2011. Like the original there are a number of treasures you need to collect, they are mostly made of precious metals and stones.

417882.overview:
Distichon is a one or two player calculation\logic game. The task is to divide a pile of tiles into two unequal piles. Piles with 1 or 2 stones are therefore eliminated. Whoever makes the last move wins. The 1st pile consists of eleven game pieces. The dividing arrow is moved up and down with the cursor keys.

The game is all in German, and was released as part of the 4k BASIC Compo 2009.
