417915.overview: Depotmaster: Finsbury Park is a train simulation in which you control the trains that runs at North London's Finsbury Park Station. It was released around the same time as Depotmaster: Old Oak Common.

417916.overview:
Hot-Food (also known in Italy as Dentiera) is a clone of the old Atari 2600 game, Fast Food for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Volker Wiewer and published in the following:

- 64'er Sonderheft 1985/03
- Game 2000 N°10 (Gennaio 1986)

The game itself also plays a rendition of the Star Wars theme while the game is being played.

417935.overview: Move your driller and collect all oil deposits. Avoid the blinking glassoid of doom. Press fire to retract the driller. Created by Georg Rottensteiner for the 4k BASIC Compo 2009.

417937.overview: A simple text adventure created by Paul Allen Panks and released to PD in 2008. Made as a cartridge and was intended to honor the passing and contributions of the coder\creator Paul Allen Panks aka Dunric by his friend Clockmeister.

417945.overview: A German language text adventure based on the Steve Jackson\Ian Livingstone "gamebook" pirate book. That book had already been converted to a game in 1985 called Seas of Blood, but this is based on entirely different code, which, in turn, also had a re-release in 2022 with bugfixes and NTSC fixes in English in 2022. Play them all, it is a fun story!

418037.overview: A PD text adventure created by Shaun Bebbington for the Commodore 64 Crap Game Compo 2006 (C64CGC). You find yourself in a land surrounded by donkeys contentedly eating the verdant grass but aren't sure how you got here or even where *here* is!

418043.overview: A public domain fantasy role-playing text adventure by Paul Allen Panks, released in 2006. You start in a tavern, where all good adventures start.

418047.overview: An overhead view 2D RPG from Markus Stehr and released to PD in the 1K Minigame Wettbewerb 2006.

418227.overview: A Pinball game created with the Pinball Construction Set for 1-4 players by , published Charles M. Duncan (CMD) in the  PCS Club Disk #02, and then later in Stonysoft #1725.

418769.overview: In Deathflood - Dungeon of Doom you are locked deep down in a dark dungeon full of evil creatures, traps and a constantly rising flood. Your main goal is quite simple: To escape this hostile place...alive. At second glance, your quest might not as easy as expected. There are additional objectives, hidden secrets, some nasty pitfalls and several choices to make.

419367.overview: In this clone of Dr. Mario, you play Dr. Maria who like her more famous counterpart destroys viruses by throwing colored pills into the bottle. As the pill drops, you can rotate them. Match four of the same color vertically or horizontally to clear them. When all the viruses in a bottle are cleared, you progress to the next level.

420288.overview: Habitat is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed by LucasArts. It is the first attempt at a large-scale commercial virtual community that was graphic based. Initially created in 1985 by Randy Farmer, Chip Morningstar, Aric Wilmunder and Janet Hunter the game was made available as a beta test in 1986 by Quantum Link, an online service for the Commodore 64 computer and the corporate progenitor to AOL. Both Farmer and Morningstar were given a First Penguin Award at the 2001 Game Developers Choice Awards for their innovative work on Habitat. As a graphical MUD[7] it is considered a forerunner of modern MMORPGs unlike other online communities of the time (i.e. MUDs and massively multiplayer onlines with text-based interfaces). Habitat had a GUI and large user base of consumer-oriented users, and those elements in particular have made Habitat a much-cited project and acknowledged benchmark for the design of today's online communities that incorporate accelerated 3D computer graphics and immersive elements into their environments.

421105.overview: This game is a homage to Dig Dug, an arcade game developed by Namco in 1982.

421109.overview:
The kingdom's sworn enemy, the dragon, has been finally caught. As the prince it's your job to execute him. However, something feels off about the dragon...

An enhanced text adventure with authentic PETSCII graphics and atmospheric SID music.

421162.overview:
Gameplay:

-    Control the traffic to allow cars to safely cross the intersection. 
-    The faster cars exit the screen, the more points are scored.
-    If cars are stopped for too long or stop inside the intersection, your score will reduce quickly.
-    If any cars crash, it's game over!

Controls:

-    Joystick in Port 2 (arrow keys). 
-    Left to stop and restart traffic in eastbound lane
-    Right for westbound
-    Up for southbound
-    Down for northbound
-    Fire to restart game

Written over a couple of evenings for the C64 Cassette 50 Competition using 6502 assembly in KickAssembler, with all code and data to be below $1000.

424160.overview:
A cosmic cloud has shrouded the land in permanent darkness. Red death rains like blood. Monsters from beyond lurk in the shadows, spawning their evil offspring. Fight them with light and fire, find a sanctuary. Survive this unholy night.

GAMEPLAY:

The controls guide the player character, and a flashlight that illuminates the ground ahead. Press fire to use the gun. Gunfire will only strike an illuminated spot, or at close point-black range near the player character. If you let the monsters or their firepower hit the player character you will lose a life. A bonus life is awarded for every 10,000 points.

424229.overview: This game was coded between 1.30PM and 5PM on November 5th 2023, during the Mamemeister Charity Steam. The aim is to collect all the diamonds on each level. When you move, you will continue moving in that direction until blocked by a wall. This means some strategy is required to make sure you can reach all the diamonds, which in later levels may mean doing them in a specific order. This initial version has 15 levels.

424869.overview:
Earth has become a hot and dry place. The struggle for food and water has led to a breakdown of civilization and caused devastating wars and destruction. From the ashes of modern society, the survivors have organized themselves into tribal structures and are fighting each other for survival in the barren wastelands.

Devolution - Global Warming is a real-time strategy game that requires quick tactical decisions and a good long-term strategy.

Your goal is to unite the survivors of the apocalypse. But there are others who are trying to do the same. To win, you have to defeat all your opponents or at least stay alive longer...

425265.overview: In this 2022 game by Kornel Kolma  with music by Niklas Broström you must search the maze for the ball and move it into the hole. Use the bars at the bottom which will tell you as you get nearer to the ball.

425381.overview:
Deep in the Caribbean lies Melee Island, ruled by the governor Elaine Marley. The cruel pirate LeChuck is deeply in love with her - so deeply that he refuses to accept his own death. As a ghost, he dwells with his undead crew somewhere near the mysterious Monkey Island. Meanwhile, a young fellow named Guybrush Threepwood is determined to become a real pirate. At the Scumm Bar, he meets three pirates who tell him he has to complete three difficult tasks in order to be worthy of this title. But as Guybrush is trying to complete these tasks, he encounters the lovely governor, and this meeting changes his life forever. Risking to incur the wrath of LeChuck, Guybrush has to prove his wit is as sharp as his sword, and figure out a way to foil the ghost pirate's plans. 
 
The puzzles are predominantly inventory-based; most of the problems in the game are solved by picking up items and combining them with each other or with objects (or people) in the game world. Several tasks are dialogue-based; among those is the humorous "insult swordfighting", which involves Guybrush learning and choosing witty insults while dueling pirates.

425386.overview: A SEUCK game in which you have to kill as many deer as possible. Ceated by Bobjack Ltd. using Chris Yates' Shoot Em Up Construction Kit. It was released in 1988.

425671.overview: Delve Deeper is a heretical roguelike dungeon crawler for the Commdore 64.

444322.overview:
Dan The Digger 10

This game was written for the Basic 10-Liner Contest 2024 in the PUR-80 category. It's written for Commodore 64/128 computers.

Aim of the game:

In this game, you control Dan, who once used to play in a sandbox. By following his passion, he becomes a great digger.

Help him find as many diamonds as you can by digging holes down. In order to get out to the surface, you can use a ladder by pressing the fire button. Be careful, as the number of ladders is limited. To refill ladders, get out to the surface and exit the level in the top right side of the screen. The number of diamonds gained on the level will be exchanged for the same number of ladders.

Be careful to not run out of ladders! If Dan cannot get to the surface, he will stay forever underground.

How many diamonds can you find? Can you uncover a single level entirely? Let's dig it!

446684.overview: Drip is a game with 15 floors (levels). You must move along the pipes of each floor and rust them to advance to the next level.

447034.overview: Depths of Zimroel (called The Sword of Zimroel in the game's instruction manual) is a text based RPG for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published in 1983 as a mail order game by Crystal Microsoft Ltd., a company based in Houston, Texas.

447091.overview: Under your control you have the most powerful truck on twitter, capable of unlocking everything that is proposed. From the Desatranques plant, they have given the alert that the roads of Jaén and its surroundings are being invaded, preventing progress. Insects, rats, garbage, kamikaze drivers, heavy trucks, ... Everything has to be unlocked! Along with the rest of the Desatranques fleet, you must make your way down the road until you arrive safely at the Desatranques facilities. Will you be able to do it?

447118.overview:
Dragonaker, our dragon, wants to go home, but what seemed like a pleasant walk turns into a great adventure. Mines, dragons, rain clouds, electric clouds, winged beings, etc. prevent the way. We will have to break through with the power of the shot of its jaws to finally face our great enemy, the great green dragon. But be careful! Not all clouds are white and vaporous and can be traversed. There are also thick gray clouds that we will not be able to pass, just the ones that Dragonaker does not feel good at all. So it is best to avoid them.

Dragonaker, is a mix between a ship shooter, in the purest classic style and one in the first person, similar to games like Combat school and its shooting range in which we will control our dragon and his sights to advance. We have defined it as “Fire and fly” style.

447625.overview:
In ‘Die Kaufmannsgilde’ you are a merchant in medieval Germany and try to become a member of the powerful merchant guild. The game consists of an economic and a strategic part, which requires tactincal decisions and long-term planning.

Features:

-    A turn based game
-    Up to four competing players
-    Challenging computer opponents
-    5 unique maps
-    Adjustable difficulty level
-    PAL/NTSC compatibility

448601.overview: Drip II: The Sequel is a game with 15 mazes. You must move along the pipes of each maze and rust them to fill the areas and advance to the next maze. After completing a maze, you'll get a code for the next maze.

451256.overview: Welcome to the sequel of THE CAMP, the super-duper text adventure! What the heck??? That adventure was difficult, in it's own texty way but was boring as hell? The action was missing? You would rather hit the shit? Then you are damn right here! Because this spin-off kicks in from the moment you filled your super t-soaker with peppermint tea... No more lazy word-clicking! Reach your anger, shake the stick and spray your brain away until the doc shows up! Free your kidnapped friends from the long fingers of the greasy aliens! Welcome to S.E.U.C.K. CAMP! A tribute to all SEUCK-, ADVENTURE- and CAMPING-FANS and to John Carpenter, Platoon, Impossible Mission, Ghost ´n Goblins, Giana Sisters and The Prodigy! (For instant fun you should hold THE CAMP (text adventure) disk at hand in the end...)

452214.overview: Decade of Ruin is a modern homebrew Commodore 64 game. It was inspired by old-school Dungeon Crawler and RPG games like Doom RPG (J2ME), Might&Magic, The Bard's Tale etc.

453481.overview:
One of two drone racing games developed for the 2024 Reset64 4KB Craptastic Game Competition.

This was developed by Carleton Handley with extra code by Saul Cross (who also did the music and some of the graphics.)

The game also borrows a bit from the C64 classic, Thrust.


Quote from Carleton:

"Every two years Reset64 Magazine run a competition to create a game for the Commodore 64 in 4kb or less. I entered in 2020 and 2022 with Blockheads and Nurikabe respectively, both can be downloaded from my page here on itch.io

Drone Zone is my 2024 effort and I wanted to do something a little more technical with this entry so this game has full screen 50/60hz scrolling. The code for that is generated at runtime as it takes over 4k of RAM on its own.

The idea of the game is to get around each of the six zones as fast as you can. With practice zones one and two can be completed in under 11 seconds so it's definitely a speed run game. 

Here are my best times if you'd like to compete against the developer:

Zone 1 - 10:56

Zone 2 - 10:66

Zone 3 - 14:36

Zone 4 - 15:02

Zone 5 - 18:02

Zone 6  - 17:42

Instructions are included in the zip as either a text file or a C64 .prg file.

The game is compatible with real C64s, TheC64 and all emulators. It will also run on PAL and NTSC machines."

454219.overview: The Dragon and the Troll is a fantasy themed text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Johan Berntsson and released into the public domain in 1987.

454397.overview:
Detroit City is a simple business sim written in Basic and published as a type-in game in a book "Creating Simulation Games on Your Computer". You play as the CEO of a struggling automobile company at a time when the U.S. car market has reached saturation. Starting with four factories and a significant financial loss, your challenge is to steer the company back to profitability. 

The game presents simplified elements of manufacturing and sales, tasking players with decisions on production levels, employee numbers, wages, and vehicle pricing. Market conditions, inflation, and factory efficiency add layers of complexity to achieving sustainable success. Success is measured by cumulative profit, with potential outcomes ranging from financial ruin to becoming a board member of the company.

456139.overview: After a huge asteroid hits Earth, ash and dust darken the sky for decades. A global ice age begins.

456398.overview: Dangerzone is a weird little shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Adamp1 using Garry Kitchen's Gamemaker. The year of release is unknown,

456502.overview: A 1-2 player SEUCK game developed by Sonny Top and released into the public domain in 2010.

456602.overview:
This game only works on PAL

This is the 1st place winner of the Official C64 SEUCK Compo 2021. Droid Rumble, is a futuristic beat 'em up written by Alf Yngve using the Sideways scrolling SEUCK. This version of the game wins the first place prize and contains the following features:

Stunning loading picture by Ax!s/TND
Freeload tape loader
Intro presentation with complete story line
Thumping technosound tracks
New front end presentation
Hi score table
Full in game enhancements, including some very special features
Artificial intelligence (enemies with smart aim firing)
Power up for every 10,000 points score (Power up is lost if caught)
The city of the future is in peril. Malfunctioning robots have taken over the fusion power plant.

You, a SWAT team officer, have volunteered to infiltrate the plant. Your mission is to shut down the reactor before it goes into meltdown.

In order to distract the robots, you will be disguised in a robot suit. You carry a plasma puncher, a powerful weapon with limited range. (You might capture other weapons inside the plant as the robots are heavily armed.)

You must disable the robots which have seized vital control panels and find the emergency shutdown key.

Unfortunately we do not know which robot is holding the key, so you have to take down all robots near the control panel. Time is running out. The main reactor might reach critical condition in less than an hour. If it does, the city is dooms and a catastrophic death toll can be expected ....

Go! Go! Go!

456714.overview: A basic action game developed by Richard Caravella and published in UpTime Vol.1 #03.

457127.overview:
This game is an enhanced remake of a title I originally created for the ColecoVision.

You play as a very famous video game hero who’s doomed to eat gums... but secretly, he hates them. What he truly loves are donuts!
So at night, he escapes from his game to explore haunted donut warehouses...

The gameplay is loosely inspired by a game called Fatty, originally released for the Sharp MZ-700.

I hope you enjoy it!

457137.overview: Copyright IBM Corp 1981, Original game Bill Gates, Neil Konzen. C-64 port by Aleksi Eeben in 2025

458650.overview:
A commercially sold SEUCK game from Italy, developed by R. Anzellotti and published by Systems Editoriale in 1989.

In Ducky Dan, the player controls Ducky Dan flying in the bubble to the heavens to rescue his beloved female duck from the clutches of evil humanoids. Break through the five levels shooting enemies with bubbles, avoiding their attacks, while collecting other bubbles. During the perilous travel in scrolling mode, the enemy medusa, coyotes, and various kinds of birds and creatures will try to eliminate the player. Eliminate opponents and gain scores. At the end of each level the different kinds of bosses appear.

459056.overview: In the days when the Wild West was roamed by bandits and murderers, lawmen had a lot to deal with. Honest sheriffs and brave rangers tracked outlaws over wild terrain, but very often they had to stop at the Mexican border, because they had no jurisdiction in Mexico.

459320.overview: The Dragon Diamond is a fantasy themed text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Kenneth Pedersen and published by Adventure Probe Software in 1987.

459644.overview: Double Take (not to be confused with the Ocean Software game of the same name) is a 2 player only gambling game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Mark Tuttle and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1988/12 (Issue #66), which was the same issue that Crossroads II: Pandemonium was released in.

459788.overview:
This is a C64 port of the Amiga game with the same name, which is also still in development.  This jump’n’run game is loosely inspired by the gameplay mechanics of Mr. Robot and His Robot Factory. 
The player's task is to collect all the popcorn kernels placed inside the platforms and reach the exit before time runs out. The player's character cannot jump, so you have to collect shields that last for a certain amount of time and allow you to eliminate enemy creatures. Only after picking up a can of drink does the player gain the ability to jump. In later stages, the game requires the player to think about how to complete the level.

460770.overview:
D.D.T. is a 1-2 player (not simultaneous) Dutch platform game for the Commodore 64. It was develped by Bob Sierhuis and released into the public domain in 1989.

In the game you have to avoid/kill the insects using the now controversial pesticide D.D.T. (Dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane) and protect and water the plants.

461279.overview: An Italian text adventure game developed by Alessandro Zanello and published in the Italian magazine: Dream #02

462590.overview: You must control Koji Kabuto as the Photonic Laboratory is invaded by Dr. Hell and his henchmen: Baron Ashura, the Headless Count, and their troops of Tetsukamen and Iron Masks.

462661.overview:
Der Kleine Hobbit ( The Little Hobbit) is a German-language text adventure (with simple graphics) that  adapts the story of the book The Hobbit by J.R.R. Tolkien. The player takes on the role of Bilbo Baggins who joins a group of dwarves led by Thorin Oakenshield and the wizard Gandalf on a quest to reclaim the dwarves’ treasure and defeat the dragon Smaug. 

Gameplay occurs via a two-word parser where the player enters commands such as NIMM SCHATZ (“take treasure”) or GEHE OSTEN (“go east”). The game world is navigated via text descriptions of rooms/locations with accompanying simple character-graphics screens. There is no character creation: the player controls Bilbo, interacts with dwarves and other NPCs, solves puzzles and gathers items while avoiding traps  and either battling or evading foes. 
 
Published in both 64'er Sonderheft 1986/04, and in 64'er Spielesammlung #3.

462859.overview:
Smugglers have stolen two sacred crystals from the "National Museum of Everything" and left a map behind of where they plan to go.

You pick up the plans and head off to the heart of Tibet, only to discover anancient mine and as you enter the mine,it closes in on you. You then discover that the mine is transcribed as the "Doom Mine", a mine, complete with an underworld.

For many centuries, tales have been told that this mine is haunted, and belongs to the ancient King Zulog. Unfortunately, one of the smugglers managed to travel across the mine and placed the crystals on the incorrect podium. The curse of King Zulog has been unleashed, and now the mine is even deadlier than you would have expected.

Playing the game

Guide Fredrik and/or Danny through four different zones inside the Doom Mine. During the adventure, you will encounter ruthless henchmen of the smugglers, who are guarding the mine. There are also some scary surprises onthe way. Try to make it to the vault and retrieve those crystals to break the curse of King Zulog.

During your quest you will encounter the smugglers, who are armed with rifles and plenty of firepower, ancient statues that fire lasers, beetles, which spit venomous poison, ghosts, tentacles, demons and much more. There will be some scary surprises on the  way.

Collect medi-kits to advance your score closer to scoring extra lives. These boxes will award you 2,000 points.

Remember, the only way in this mine is to go forward. There is definitely no turning back.

463218.overview:
People say that there is a pirate treasure buried beneath the surface of Oak Island. 
Some say it is protected by an insidious trap...

463268.overview:
Dyriun T2 is a 1-player only side scrolling shooter developed by Roberto Ricioppo of TND using the Sideways Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit mod, and was released into the public domain in 2016.

Your home planet is dying. You need to save it. You have been forced to enter the space mines to develop new energy to bring your dying planet back to life. Out to stop you are groups of mean aliens. Luckily for you, you are armed with a pulse laser cannon. Go give those aliens a good thrashing and save your beloved planet.

463695.overview: A single player shoot em up developed by Gaetano Chiummo using the shoot em up construction kit and released in 2018.

464513.overview: Take the role of a mighty dragon and guard your treasure hoard deep within your lair! Every day brings new challenges — greedy heroes, sneaky thieves, or strange magical events that can change your fate in an instant.

470751.overview: Deathly Storm: The Edge of Life aka DSTEOL, is a game inspired by the pc game of the same name. It was prepared for Commodore 64 in 2024 using the basic language.

471323.overview:
DANK ARMADA is an arcade shooter. Earth is under siege. They hide in the fractures of reality — and only a ghost ship from a dead timeline can reach them. Hunt enemies across open space. Find the portal. Assault the Woe Star. Destroy it before it feeds on the light of dying worlds.

The game was developed way back in 1986, but not officially released until 2026.

472136.overview: Dust is an Interactive Fiction game. You enter commands with your keyboard (LOOK, GO DOWN, GET LAMP, TALK TO WOMAN...) and your character will try to follow them.

472140.overview: Guide Jim through the falling mines to collect Hearts.

472472.overview: You play as a hero Dantalion, who witnessed a horrific fate of his mother, which was caused by the evil monster, Bael. Dantalion enters the Academy of Dark Arts in order to try and learn and upskill so that he can face his nightmare and defeat Bael for good. The only thing that steps in your way are his evil monsters and other obstacles. Prepare for a magical adventure.

472473.overview: Duo Tanx is a simple arena tank duel game for 2 players only. Play against a friend (or foe) and guide your tanks around the arena and prepare to do battle against your opponent. During the game there will be mystery power ups/power downs that can do good/bad to your tank. The game also features a selection of game options on the title screen which can set the maximum number of rounds to win the game. Also you can pick whether or not you want arenas to appear in order or at random. Now get into your tank and prepare for carnage.

472476.overview: Delve64 is a traditional text-based roguelike for the C64 and C64 Ultimate, adapted to the PETSCII character set.

472489.overview:
An updated version of TND's 2025 game of the same name with some graphical enhancements over the original.

Developed by TND using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit.

474151.overview: You play a courageous duck, on a mission to find each duckling and bring them home. Watch out for ladybirds and bumblebees as you waltz across this idyllic island, and collect strawberries along the way to help you reach new heights.

474329.overview: You move in an arena with snake food, bullets, bombs, lasers, walls, drones, bosses, and other level systems. The DELETE ME snake follows food, regenerates when it eats, and creates openings or danger depending on how you manage its path.

475934.overview: The daimyo are powerful lords who rule over vast lands and command mighty armies. Above them stands only the shogun, to whom they owe tribute and loyalty. Should this order collapse, chaos and war ensue…

476369.overview: DESERT PLANET GOLF is a tiny, RETRO-style, mind blowing once in a lifetime.  SCI-FI GOLF ADVENTURE! Set on a strange, sun-scorched world of twin suns, a fairly long time ago in a galaxy pretty far away.

476641.overview: Dune II: The Demake is an 8-bit demake of the MS-DOS and Amiga RTS of the same name. It was developed and released by Zoltan Varga, where it earned 1st place at 2026 Arok Party Game Dev competition.

477517.overview:
Darkwood is a public-domain text adventure series by Elise C. Boucher AKA Zosia the Pious in
the 80s. She also created some other text adventures. Darkwood 5 was considered lost, nowhere to
be found. On a webarchived version of her own page she asked anyone who had a copy of
Darkwood 5 to reach out to her. Today, we have uncovered it (broken), restored it, and can now
play the game in 2026, after 37 years!

480071.overview: Little Dungeon Crawler for the C64. 100% assembly code.

480651.overview: A Geometry Dash demake — one button, nine different meanings.

480739.overview: This is a retro-style illustrated text adventure game in the format of a horror short story. You play the part of a young gentleman, Oswald Stanley, travelling to visit an old college friend on a fine summer's evening at the height of the Victorian era.  As the night progresses, events take a sinister turn with the emergence of a murderous evil spirit. What follows will chill Oswald to the very marrow, but will you be able to guide him safely through the night?

480840.overview:
Catch one in your beam and it stops where it stands. Hold the beam on it and it begins to burn — green, then yellow, then white, then nothing at all.
So the flashlight is your eyes and your only weapon, and it points one way. Light the path ahead and everything behind you wakes up and starts walking. Light the pack behind you and you go forward blind.

480953.overview: A short text adventure for the Commodore 64 set in the world of the Gold Quest game series. Has modes for both German and English language play.

481198.overview: The middle game of the id trilogy for the Commodore 64.

481347.overview: DROP64 is a brand-new game for the Commodore 64, written from scratch in 6502 assembly. You drop down a deep shaft with gunboots strapped to your feet: fire jumps you off the ground, and in the air it shoots straight down, slowing your fall. Stomp on monsters, blast through blocks, chain kills without landing and collect the gems they leave behind, all the way down to the Warden waiting at the bottom of the sixth depth.

481577.overview: Duel 64 è un frenetico gioco di duelli 1 contro 1 che cattura lo spirito e la tensione di classici come TowerFall Ascension . Due arcieri si affrontano fino alla morte in arene dinamiche e generate casualmente, saltando freneticamente da una piattaforma all'altra mentre si scambiano frecce.

481673.overview: DAYBREAK GP is a Formula 1 endurance racer for the Commodore 64, inspired by classic Enduro. It's written entirely in 6502 assembler. Every in-game day you have to overtake a set number of rival cars before the sun comes up again. Miss the quota and your race is over.

481811.overview: Defend your cities against waves of deadly drones in this action-packed C64 arcade game! Read the readme text file very carefully; it is the manual for this game.

481819.overview: Fly your drone suit deep into Mount Azure, blast through the walls and laser the spiders and bats to rescue all 8 trapped miners.

481950.overview: Deep Delve 64 is a roguelike for the Commodore 64 (C64), written in C and running on a stock machine: a real C64, a C64 Ultimate, or an emulator such as VICE. No memory expansion, no cartridge.

481993.overview: Well, that didn't work out... You entered a dungeon seeking fame and fortune except this dungeon offers neither. Now, its just a scramble to get out alive and there is only one way to do that.

482037.overview:
The game that hates you. A brand-new troll platformer for the Commodore 64. Every level looks easy. None of them are. Floors vanish, spikes pop out of nowhere, ceilings come down, doors run away from you and gravity changes its mind.
Die. Learn. Die again.

482048.overview: Somewhere on planet Neuro lies a mysterious crater, so deep that nobody has ever seen its bottom. You send a probe down the shaft to find out what's waiting there.

482050.overview: Drive America is a point-to-point endurance racer for the C64. Start in the shadow of the Manhattan skyline and race west across the United States, picking your route at every state line in true Out Run style, until you roll into sunny California. Ten rivals want that trophy too, and the weather, the traffic and the local wildlife are not on your side.

482169.overview:
DEATHCHASE 64 brings the legendary ZX Spectrum game 3D Deathchase to the Commodore 64, recreating its distinctive high-speed motorcycle combat through dense forests.
Originally developed by Mervyn J. Estcourt and published by Micromega in 1983, 3D Deathchase became a celebrated classic of the 8-bit era, renowned for its remarkable sense of speed, atmospheric environments and addictive gameplay.

482264.overview: You can crouch to avoid all enemy attacks, however the androids will get more clever and may hit you while you are crouching.

482274.overview: Fight your way down through 26 levels of monster-filled dungeons. Monsters pour out of generators – shoot them, or shoot the generators themselves. Grab keys to open treasure chests, eat food to stay alive, stay away from poison, pick up weapon, armour and shield power-ups, and find the ladder down to the next level before your health runs out. Play alone or team up with a friend.

482568.overview: Defender 64 is a fan independent adaptation of the Williams arcade classic, created by Realite for Commodore 64.

482598.overview: Two robot vacuum cleaners, one old house, four bugs with very big eyes.

482619.overview: Deathdream is a 1-2 player (co-operative) vertically scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Ibersoft using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit in 1990.

482620.overview: Deathdream2 (also known as Deathdream 2 and Deathdream II) is a 1-2 player (co-operative) vertically scrolling SHMUP for the Commodore 64. It is the sequel to Ibersoft's Deathdream and was released later during the same year as the first game.

482843.overview: The Game of Deathly Adventure (also known as simply Deathly Adventure)  is a Finnish maze-based action-adventure game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Toni Luode, and published in Floppy Magazine 1988/1.

482957.overview: A few years ago, I started working on a side-scrolling beat 'em up for the C64, but the hardware limitations and the rather repetitive nature of the arcade genre, often designed to encourage players to keep feeding coins into the machines, eventually made me rethink the project.At that point, I decided to try bringing the fantastic Technos NES title, Double Dragon II, to our beloved Commodore 64.
